title: S08T02 - Implement SQLite generated cache adapter behind the store boundary
description: Add a cache adapter that can be rebuilt from canonical files and queried by dashboards without making SQLite the hidden source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Cache rebuild is idempotent and doctor-checkable.
closedReason: SQLite cache rebuild is idempotent, doctor-checkable, queryable for dashboard reads, and does not replace the file-store source of truth.
